_comment: Spoken lines for English (docs/design/voices.md), keyed by id: social interaction ids, animation tags (`action`), emotion ids and planner thought kinds. Other languages get their own file (content/voice/<lang>.json) with the same keys. {name} is the other resident's first name, {me} the speaker's. A line may fix a pronunciation with [word](/phonemes/) (Misaki's alphabet). Optional tone per group: happy, sad, angry, flirty.

start: Hi, I'm {me}. Nice to meet you!
Hello there! I don't think we've met.
Hey, I'm {me}. And you are?
How was your day, {name}?
Did you see the weather today?
So, what have you been up to?
Have you tried the new café in town?
good: Not bad at all. How about you?
bad: I'd rather not talk right now.

start: Want to hear a joke? Why did the scarecrow win a prize? He was outstanding in his field!
What do you call a sleeping dinosaur? A dino snore!
I told my plants a joke. They didn't laugh, but they grew a little.
good: Oh no, that's terrible. I love it!
bad: Was that supposed to be a joke?

start: You look great today, {name}!
I really like your style.
You always make me smile.
good: Aw, thank you! That's so sweet.
bad: Are you making fun of me?

start: Do you ever wonder what we're all here for?
What's the one thing you'd change about your life?
Can I tell you something personal?
good: I think about that all the time.
I'm really glad you told me.
bad: That's a bit too deep for me right now.
I don't really want to get into that.

start: Come here, you need a hug!
Hug?
Has anyone told you your eyes are lovely?
Is it warm in here, or is it just you?
I could listen to you all day, {name}.
You make every day better, {name}.
I keep thinking about you.
good: You always know what to say.

start: Come here, you.
Can I kiss you?
{name}, will you be my partner?
I want us to be together. What do you say?
bad: I'm sorry. I don't feel the same way.
I need some time to think.

start: We need to talk about us.
I think we should go our separate ways.
bad: I can't believe this is happening.

start: You really are a piece of work, {name}.
Did you get dressed in the dark?
Wow. Just wow.
You're wrong, and you know it!
Why do you always do this?
We need to settle this right now.
good: Fine, maybe you have a point.

start: Hey {name}, look over there!
Ha! Gotcha!
good: Okay, you got me. Nice one!
I'll get you back for that.

start: That's it, I've had enough of you!
Come on then!
good: Ow! Okay, okay, I give up!

start: I'm sorry, {name}. I didn't mean it.
Can you forgive me?
bad: I'm not ready to forgive you.

cook: Let's see what we have in the fridge.
shower: A nice hot shower. Just what I needed.
bath: A long bath sounds perfect right now.
sleep: I can barely keep my eyes open.
sit: Ah, it feels good to sit down.
read: Where was I? Oh yes, chapter three.
paint: A little more blue, I think.
clean: This place is a mess. Somebody has to clean it.
garden: Time to get my hands dirty.
tend: Let's see how the plants are doing.
harvest: Look at these! Fresh from the garden.
admire: I could look at this all day.
write: Let me write this down before I forget.

lines: Is it just me, or is love in the air?
Ugh, everything is annoying me today!
Oh no, that was so embarrassing.
I'm really in the zone today.
I really don't feel like it today.
I wish we had somewhere to do that.
There's nowhere to do that here.
I did it! I actually did it!
